worktree: paired CFG branches in one pass of two-row GEMV launches

claim.what: The two CFG branches share every projection weight, so one two-row launch per projection replaces two one-row launches. Each row keeps the single-row kernel's K traversal and local-256 reduction order, so the change is arithmetic-neutral: the AR step and the generated audio are bit-identical to the serial path.
claim.not_claimed: No reference (torch) arm exists on this host, so this is an absolute gfx1100 measurement and a serial-versus-paired ratio, not a ratio against the upstream implementation.

kernel_ab.protocol: per-row bit-identity against the single-row kernel on the production shapes, plus an FP64 outer check; rows 1, 2 and 3 (odd row count runs the second block with one row)
kernel_ab.note: A separate per-kernel microbenchmark was discarded: at these matrix sizes the weight matrix stays in Navi31's Infinity Cache across repetitions, so its GB/s figures (1.3-3.0 TB/s) describe cache bandwidth and not the 2.8 GB-per-branch weight stream the runtime actually pulls from HBM. Only the end-to-end runtime timings below are reported.

step_profile.protocol: Yue2ArRuntime(branches=2) on the song pipeline's resident 16000-token context, mandarin-off-s1234 prefixes, 900 warm steps to reach product depth, then 150 timed steps with a device synchronize after the head, after the sampler and after the forward so each segment is attributed without queue backpressure

identity.rows_compared: logits and both branch hidden rows, every step

depth_scan.protocol: paired forward only, 150 timed steps at each depth, synchronize per segment
depth_scan.finding: The fixed part of a paired forward is 12.18 ms; the remaining 18.0 ms at product depth is span attention, which is 60% of the forward there and grows linearly in context. The projection GEMVs are no longer the dominant term at depth.

product_path.protocol: one live request through hipengine.LLM.generate() with the registered yue2 plugin (cot=off, seed 20260916, 32 ODE steps, tiled decoder, 1862 latent frames / 74.479 s of audio), then a repeat in the same process

gates_rerun.session_gate: 3/3 cases PASS, teacher-forced agreement identical to the committed gfx1100 artifact (ABC 0.991 / 0.998, semantic 0.980 / 0.969 / 0.967)
gates_rerun.product: one live request plus an in-process repeat, bit-identical audio identity
gates_rerun.not_rerun: the 12-case end-to-end fixture gate and the 18-case AR replay; both were run at 9b1e0fc41 and this change is bit-identical to that revision's step arithmetic
